services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: This stage is brought to you by a donation of materials and construction from Ethos West Construction for which we are grateful! This space is excellent for poetry readings, small music groups, workshops and lectures. Available Capacity: mostly standing room, seating is limited, folding chairs, if needed, would need to be rented and brought in. New Prospect Theatre has several options for venue rental. Please send an email to our gmail account for a quote. Please fill out as much info as possible to get an accurate quote. Include the preferred dates, alternate dates, show title, contact person’s info, set style (Fringe or installed), registered company’s name (if you have one) and any other
